page.overview:
Who is Agent Charge?

8635 Mission 6: Mobile Command Base 8636 Mission 7: Deep Sea Quest 8971 Aerial Defense Unit

Agent Charge is an Agents minifigure introduced in 2008. He has been in four sets during 2008 and one in Agents 2.0 during 2009.

In 8971 Aerial Defense Unit, he wore body armour.

Agent Charge can pilot sea, air, and land vehicles, and he is an engineering-systems specialist.
